versions.changelog:
- Initial release supporting creation of evidence-led technology competitive-intelligence reports for defined organizations, technologies, and markets.
- Provides structured HTML briefings with modular templates (V8, V11, V12), prioritizing V12 for comprehensive KPI and evidence panel display.
- Ensures analyst-reviewed evidence register, transparent scope, scoring, and clear separation of sourced data, calculations, assumptions, and recommendations.
- Maps competitors, patents, markets, customers, partners, and events, supporting actionable R&D decisions with audit trails and explicit limitations.
- Integrates recommended data connectors (PatSnap MCPs) and robust QA gates for report consistency, completeness, and factual integrity.
